title: Field Sessions
intro:
For High-achieving men over 40 who are done thinking in circles and need a real environment to think clearly in.

You get out of your own theoretical space and into a working inner process — lightweight, portable, and yours to keep.

title: Strategy Intensive
intro:
For Experienced founders and operators who are high-functioning and quietly stuck.

You leave knowing exactly what you're building, who it's for, and what the next three moves are — not because someone handed you a plan, but because you cleared the noise long enough to trust your own judgment again.
